seo.title: Custom Software Development: Web, Mobile & Business Apps
seo.description: Get your web platform, mobile app or business software built by a team that plans it, builds it and keeps it running after launch. Free first consultation.

hero.title: Your idea, built properly and ready for real use.
hero.lead: Web platforms, mobile apps and business software, planned and built by one team. You see a new working version every one to two weeks, and everything we build belongs to you.
bullets: Written scope and estimate before you commit
You own the code, the accounts and the data
hero.whatsappMessage: Hello Atlaxys, I would like an estimate for a software project.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
points: A previous project looked great in the demo but broke in real use.
You cannot get a straight answer on cost or timing.
Your developer disappeared, and so did access to your code.
Your team still types the same data into three different tools.

solution.title: How we build
solution.text: We start by understanding your business and writing down the plan. Then we build in short cycles you can test yourself, and we stay after launch.

points.title: Understand first
points.text: Workshops and a written scope, so everyone agrees on what is being built.

points.title: Regular working versions
points.text: A private test site you can try from the first weeks of the project.

points.title: Ready for real use
points.text: Automated tests, monitoring and backups from day one.

points.title: Support after launch
points.text: Maintenance and improvements, or a clean handover to your team.

items.title: A clear estimate before you commit
items.text: Price ranges and the assumptions behind them, so the invoices hold no surprises.

items.title: No middlemen
items.text: You talk directly to the people building your software, in English, French or Arabic.

items.title: Full ownership
items.text: Code, hosting accounts and domain names registered to you from the first day.

proof.title: How to judge us
proof.text: We would rather show than claim. Ask us for any of these during the first call.

items.title: An example system plan
items.text: See how we plan and document a system before building it.

items.title: A test-site walkthrough
items.text: See how you would follow the progress of your project.

items.title: Our own products
items.text: Software we build and maintain ourselves, to the same standards.

items.title: Ownership in writing
items.text: Intellectual property and account ownership written into the contract before any work starts.

process.title: From first message to project in four steps

steps.title: Send your idea
steps.text: The form takes two minutes. Rough ideas are welcome.

steps.title: Free call
steps.text: 30 minutes to understand your goals and constraints.

steps.title: Written proposal
steps.text: Scope, phases, price range and timeline.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: A new working version every one to two weeks, with you involved throughout.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. After the free call, you receive a written estimate with a price range, so you can decide with all the information in hand.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: A focused tool often takes four to eight weeks. Larger platforms are delivered in phases over several months.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Morocco?
items.answer: Yes. We work with clients in Morocco and abroad, mostly remotely.
